title: 博客搭建
content: # 文章加密 1. 安装插件 `npm install --save hexo-blog-encrypt` 2. 设置文章配置 ```txt --- title: 我的私人日记 date: 2026-10-21 12:00:00 tags: - 日记 password: "password" abstract: "日记内容" message: "请输入访问密码" wrong_pass_message: "密码错误，请重新输入。" --- ``` # 修改自动生成的文件头 1. 找到`\scaffolds\post.md` 2. 修改成 ```text --- title: "{{ title }}" date: {{ date }} tags: [] password: "" abstract: "" message: "" wrong_pass_message: "" --- ``` # 解决`hexo d`的网络问题 产生原因：开了代理 解决方式： 1. 在自己的代理中找到端口 2. 在运行`hexo d` 前设置 ``` $env:HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:端口号" $env:HTTPS_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:端口号" ``` # 解决博客emoji不渲染问题 目前只有一个笨办法 ```html 表情 ``` 要找表情可以到这个网站：[markdown-it-emoji](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it-emoji/blob/master/lib/data/light.mjs)

title: Hello World
content:
Welcome to [Hexo](https://hexo.io/)! This is your very first post. Check [documentation](https://hexo.io/docs/) for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in [troubleshooting](https://hexo.io/docs/troubleshooting.html) or you can ask me on [GitHub](https://github.com/hexojs/hexo/issues).

## Quick Start

### Create a new post

``` bash
$ hexo new "My New Post"
```

More info: [Writing](https://hexo.io/docs/writing.html)

### Run server

``` bash
$ hexo server
```

More info: [Server](https://hexo.io/docs/server.html)

### Generate static files

``` bash
$ hexo generate
```

More info: [Generating](https://hexo.io/docs/generating.html)

### Deploy to remote sites

``` bash
$ hexo deploy
```

More info: [Deployment](https://hexo.io/docs/one-command-deployment.html)
